Today is National Senior Fraud Awareness Day.

Millions of elderly Americans fall victim to financial fraud every year.

As AI continues to develop before our eyes, now more than ever, it is imperative that we we raise awareness of these cruel scams that target our loved ones. https://t.co/XQvmbsAcU3

This week my team attended a briefing held by the Greater Fort Myers Chamber of Commerce.

Together, panelists & attendees discussed new developments in artificial intelligence technology & how they can be utilized to streamline small business operations throughout our community. https://t.co/souvHbdnqo

The future of finance is the digital assets space.

The future of technology is AI.

If our nation is to remain a dominant global force in the future of finance and technology...

1 – We have to increase baseload power
2 – We have to modernize the grid https://t.co/F5lkcJA7Ol

Digital assets and blockchain technology hold vast potential to revolutionize the American economy.

This afternoon, I joined my colleagues on the @FinancialCmte Digital Assets, Financial Technology, and AI Subcommittee to examine existing-use cases with key industry actors. https://t.co/4xZM5a1OHS

ICYMI: Last night, the US House of Representatives PASSED S.146 – "The TAKE IT DOWN Act" with a vote of 409-2.

This important bill endorsed by @MELANIATRUMP protects ALL AMERICANS from AI-generated nonconsensual imagery & requires social media companies to TAKE DOWN such images. https://t.co/IGcys2BRge https://t.co/4cUoZgquKV

statements.text: I think the difference now is that seeing the evolutions of AI, which, quite frankly, are just starting, and there are going to be things we are going to be talking about in a decade we would not even be thinking about today in his hearing. I think it is more about making sure that kids going through the K-12 system primarily, but then also through higher education, are learning how to leverage AI and these tools to actually become far more productive, far more innovative, and then as a byproduct, having their labor be able to have a different set of value in the economy to come.
statements.context: Remarks by Mr. Donalds at a congressional hearing titled 'The Federal Government in the Age of Artificial Intelligence.'

statements.text:
As our economy has evolved, there have been inflection points caused by disruptive technologies.

AI is the newest disruptive technology at our disposal & it's powered through an energy-intensive process.

It's imperative that our nation embraces nuclear energy to fill the void. https://t.co/OVgekuu5BA

.@SecDef: "Energy security is national security. If we don't have reliable energy for our basing, for our troops, whether forward-deployed or domestically, we're vulnerable. So by having small modular nuclear capabilities, which are rapidly being fielded, that we can use on our bases here and around the world, we're creating an environment where if things happen elsewhere, the military can be relied-upon...Also, we're including artificial intelligence in everything we do. If we don't, we're not fast enough, we're not keeping up with adversaries. You need the energy to fuel it, nuclear is a huge part of that, modular or otherwise. So, we're going to have the lights-on, and AI operating when others do not, faster than everybody else because of nuclear capabilities, so this is a big game change for us as well."

Executive Order: "Deploying Advanced Nuclear Reactor Technologies for National Security"

Description: "What this executive order will do is speed-up the approval and adoption process for specialized nuclear reactors at [defense and AI installations]. It also involves @ENERGY making available the necessary fuel stock. It also creates a special envoy position and a strategy around nuclear technology export–the idea being that we can grow American industry on the back of foreign purchasers who are interested in this sort of technology as well." – @willscharf

AI is revolutionizing our world.
AI is here to stay.
AI is energy-intensive.

And nuclear energy is the way that we ensure American dominance in the AI space. https://t.co/hoZdqfEq7F

statements.text: If you’re going to talk about areas of disagreement, one where we have a slight disagreement is on AI policy. I think that the states do need to lead when it comes to setting a regulatory framework.

statements.text: I stand with the Governor and our state law: -Local control. If a community doesn’t want a data center — no data center. -Your bills do not go up. -Our water is protected.

I want to be crystal clear: Florida law, signed by Gov. [Ron] DeSantis, puts control over data centers being built in the hands of local government. Local government will decide these matters, because they are the ones who issue bhilding permits. We are not going to preempt local governments, we are not going to override local governments.
